windowDays.description: Requested target window length; 10 or 30 trading sessions.
windowDays.title: Windowdays

scenario.description: pre_open uses the prior close; current uses the observation-date price; next_session rolls the candidate boundary forward one session.
scenario.title: Scenario

tradingSessions.description: Observed statistic sessions in the selected maximum-deviation interval; the baseline price point is excluded.
tradingSessions.title: Tradingsessions

availableTradingSessions.description: Observed statistic sessions available in this scenario, excluding the baseline and any unobserved target session.
availableTradingSessions.title: Availabletradingsessions

windowStatus.description: Whether the available observations form the requested window or a supported partial window.
windowStatus.title: Windowstatus

coverageStatus.description: Historical coverage and inferred-stock-gap summary for this row.
coverageStatus.title: Coveragestatus

startDate.description: First statistic session in the interval selected for maximum deviation; not the earliest candidate boundary.
startDate.title: Startdate

baselineDate.description: Compatibility date for the stock return baseline; equal to stockBaselineDate.
baselineDate.title: Baselinedate

stockBaselineDate.description: Date of the stock price used as the return baseline.
stockBaselineDate.title: Stockbaselinedate

benchmarkBaselineDate.description: Date of the index point used as the return baseline; it may differ from the stock baseline after an inferred halt.
benchmarkBaselineDate.title: Benchmarkbaselinedate

endDate.description: Date of the stock and benchmark terminal prices used in this row.
endDate.title: Enddate

targetDate.description: Trading date that defines the candidate-window boundary; for next_session this is a future calendar date with no price data read.
targetDate.title: Targetdate

inferredHaltDates.description: Missing stock Kline dates inferred as a gap between observed stock bars; index gaps are never inferred as halts.
inferredHaltDates.title: Inferredhaltdates

stockBaselinePrice.description: Stock return baseline in CNY per share, on the priceBasis reported by DeviationData.
stockBaselinePrice.title: Stockbaselineprice

windowStartPrice.description: Stock price at startDate in CNY per share; distinct from the preceding baseline price.
windowStartPrice.title: Windowstartprice

currentPrice.description: Terminal stock price in CNY per share, using the source and date selected for this scenario.
currentPrice.title: Currentprice

benchmarkInstrument.description: Full identity of the board-specific benchmark index.

benchmarkName.description: Human-readable name of the board-specific benchmark index.
benchmarkName.title: Benchmarkname

benchmarkStart.description: Benchmark baseline in index points; retained under its existing field name.
benchmarkStart.title: Benchmarkstart

benchmarkCurrent.description: Terminal benchmark value in index points, on endDate.
benchmarkCurrent.title: Benchmarkcurrent

stockReturn.description: Stock return ratio from stockBaselinePrice to currentPrice; 0.03 means 3%.
stockReturn.title: Stockreturn

benchmarkReturn.description: Benchmark return ratio from benchmarkStart to benchmarkCurrent; 0.03 means 3%.
benchmarkReturn.title: Benchmarkreturn

deviation.description: stockReturn minus benchmarkReturn for the candidate interval with the greatest deviation; negative values are preserved.
deviation.title: Deviation

upperThreshold.description: Fixed upper threshold ratio: 1.00 for 10 sessions or 2.00 for 30 sessions.
upperThreshold.title: Upperthreshold

remainingToUpper.description: Rounded upperTriggerPrice divided by currentPrice minus 1; negative values are preserved.
remainingToUpper.title: Remainingtoupper

upperTriggerPrice.description: Minimum theoretical stock price across eligible candidates, rounded up to CNY 0.01 after selection; CNY per share.
upperTriggerPrice.title: Uppertriggerprice

upperTriggerPrice_original.description: Unrounded theoretical price for the selected minimum-price candidate; CNY per share.
upperTriggerPrice_original.title: Uppertriggerprice Original

stockSourceTimestamp.description: Source-reported timestamp for a live stock quote; null when the row uses daily close data.
stockSourceTimestamp.title: Stocksourcetimestamp

benchmarkSourceTimestamp.description: Source-reported timestamp for a live benchmark quote; null when the row uses daily close data.
benchmarkSourceTimestamp.title: Benchmarksourcetimestamp

InstrumentId.description: Identity for an instrument whose code, market, and kind are already known.
InstrumentId.title: InstrumentId

description: Public computed result returned inside FetchResult.

instrumentId.description: Full identity of the requested A-share equity.

board.description: Resolved board used to select the benchmark index.
board.title: Board

asOf.description: Normalized observation trading date shared by the scenario rows.
asOf.title: Asof

effectiveAsOf.description: Legacy alias retained for migration; it matches asOf and is not a shared window end date.
effectiveAsOf.title: Effectiveasof

calculationMode.description: Legacy summary label retained for migration; each window's scenario determines its price source.
calculationMode.title: Calculationmode

priceBasis.description: Reports the actual stock Kline adjustment and raw index points: qfq_stock__raw_index when the provider returns QFQ bars, or raw_stock__raw_index when it falls back to unadjusted day bars. A stock quote bridges QFQ history by previousClose only for QFQ bars; raw stock history and quotes stay on their source price scale.
priceBasis.title: Pricebasis

ruleVersion.description: Identifier for the frozen deviation threshold and scenario algorithm.
ruleVersion.title: Ruleversion

coverageStatus.description: Aggregate historical coverage summary across the requested scenario rows.
coverageStatus.title: Coveragestatus

inferredHaltDates.description: Union of stock-gap dates inferred by the requested rows.
inferredHaltDates.title: Inferredhaltdates

windows.description: Flat records ordered by requested window and then pre_open, current, next_session.
windows.title: Windows

title: Market Deviation Computed Capability v2
